channel.title: Rift
channel.description: Updates for Rift — review, blame & verify AI-generated code from Coursion.

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
Custom 3D iconography, a reworked agent chat, and a public Homebrew tap.

  • Agent chat: drag files in from the tree or tab bar, paste code as an attachment chip, and @-mention files to add context
  • Chat history: New task now archives rather than discards, and reopening a past task resumes the agent session
  • Message actions: copy, retry, and edit-and-resend on any turn; code blocks can be inserted at the cursor
  • Custom soft-3D glyphs across empty states and starter cards
  • PR comments moved into the Inspector, alongside the other per-file review surfaces
  • Now installable from the public tap: brew install --cask coursion-studio/tools/rift

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
First public release of Rift — a native macOS cockpit for reviewing, blaming, and verifying AI-generated code.

  • Agent panel with drag-and-drop file context, paste-as-attachment, and @-mentions
  • Per-line origin (blame) and agent-session attribution in the Inspector
  • On-device risk triage on staged diffs, with deep Claude review on demand
  • Monaco-backed editor, diffs, and inline staging
  • PR review threads alongside the code
  • Hardened against untrusted-repo git config execution
